name: Views of You
source:
Moving to Cloverfield means having a fresh new start.

University life will surely be full of drama.
Meet new people
Fall in love 
Solve a...missing persons' case?

Maybe this city isn't as peaceful as it seems. 

[From [url=https://digitalmaeri.itch.io/views-of-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搬到科洛弗意味着一个全新的开始。

大学生活一定会充满戏剧性。
结识新朋友
坠入爱河 
解决…失踪案？

也许这座城市并不像看上去那么平静。
